title: pvWriteXMLTableWriter
body:
## pvWriteXMLTableWriter

Explicit-export writer that saves a table (vtkTable), such as probe-over-line, integration or statistics results, as a VTK XML Table file (.vtt) that keeps every column with its name, type and component count. Unlike pvWriteCSVWriter it is binary-capable and lossless, and Schemaxis verifies the reopened file with an exact comparison. Automatic geometry output already writes .vtt for tables; choose this writer for encoding control or an explicit export receipt. The input must be a single table, not a dataset with point or cell data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Datasets (meshes) are rejected; convert them to a table upstream if you need tabular output.
- Choose CSV (pvWriteCSVWriter) instead when the file must be read by spreadsheets or scripts that do not understand VTK XML.
- ChooseArraysToWrite true is rejected at planning (ARRAY_SELECTION_UNVERIFIABLE) because the exact comparison needs every input array in the file; filter arrays with pvPassArrays and export that node.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) passed only on a small serial fixture with default options; no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the export on representative data.

Native constructor: `XMLTableWriter`. Identity: `writers/XMLTableWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkTable"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellDataArrays` | Select the cell data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ChooseArraysToWrite` | Explicitly choose which arrays to write. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `CompressionLevel` | A compression performance parameter from 1 (faster/larger compressed filesize) to 9 (slower/smaller compressed filesize). | `{"type":"enum","values":["1","2","3","4","5","6","7","8","9"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"1"` |
| `CompressorType` | The compression algorithm used to compress binary data (appended mode only). None offers fastest write, LZ4 offers fastest compressed write, ZLib offers balanced performance, LZMA offers smallest compressed filesize. | `{"type":"enum","values":["None","LZ4","ZLib","LZMA"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"None"` |
| `DataMode` | The mode uses for writing the file's data i.e. ascii, binary, appended binary. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Ascii","Binary","Appended"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Ascii"` |
| `EdgeDataArrays` | Select the edge data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `EncodeAppendedData` | When EncodeAppendedData is turned ON, the writer uses base64 encoding when writing binary data (only if appended mode is selected). | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FieldDataArrays` | Select the field data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointDataArrays` | Select the point data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `RowDataArrays` | Select the row data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `VertexDataArrays` | Select the vertex data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "exact",
  "extensions": [
    "vtt"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWriteXMLTableWriter"
}
```
